translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

content: Seekeemmafa Dinnaa nammarina mandaikamma amaqanau.
Moo kari Dinnaa nammarifa Yakooboosa Reeaa nammarisa niraamuna fannoo Dinnaa nammarifa Kannaa maqannaa aanaaseeuqa nindafaanee qimaseenoo finau.
Seekeemmafa Amoorana amaaku Qifina aiku asaukukinaafa mi maqa maaqanakinaasa uriqararafa Dinnaa nammarina aanai paqurimaseenoo rarisanau.
Mifa qafoofanoo Dinnaa nammarifa kaaqa amiqirafa marufanoo amuqusa mandaikufanoo amiqira ufannoo mi manaaqana amuqusa reendeenianee qimasee amiqira ufauqa qinau.
Seekeemmafa narí akoona Qamoorana qimaminau. Anee maa manaaqana feefaurumma qiminaqa qinaaqara maraa.
Yakooboofa narí araamuna Dinnaa nammarina rarisoonara iriseenoo kasoo inoo marinau. Narí faiqi namu narí aandausaa rakisi marusa nianai marufanoo nifeesi marinau.
Seekeemmana akoofa Ammoorafa Yakooboona faqa ufa qirara finau.

Oonuroofaqa kai Yakooboona faiqi namu aandausaa rakisiusa aniraqau. Misa Dinnaa nammarina rarisoonara irufanoo sia faiqí auqaaqaa ira ainaina marufaqa kaaqa niranaqeenoo nifai sandurinau. Seekeemmafa Yakooboona araamuna rarisoonannoo Isaraee maqannaasa nuqu mara maree quminau.
Qamoorafa maaqi qimasee Yakooboona qimaminau. Qini qimaaku Seekeemmana irirafa ani araamunara firaaqoo aqufifaqa ani qimamidaqa. Amanee mina maraannoo fee.
Sainaqa maasa moodaanaki kira ufa qimasaanaqa kaqi ani maqannaa faqa qini maqannaa faqa kaqi narí maree narí maree iaqa.
Miqi mandaanaqa innee maa maqanasaa maridaqa kaqi dapi maa maqa maaqanaki oonuree aniree idaqa maqa akausa mariaqa.
Seekeemmafa Dinnaa nammarina akoona faqa asooqmaaka faqa qimanniminoo qinau. Innee qini didi marindee masaifaqa inni nidi mari ainaina nimianaura.
Inni nidi mari ainainnara qimaqimifaqa nimianaura. Firaa feefauruara qifaqa nimianaura. Innee qiniara mina maraannee qimasee innee iraifandinna ainainna kai nimianaura.
Miqi qimasoofaqa Yakooboona faiqi namu nári nisookina rarisoonara iriseeqa akaru qira ufa Seekeemmana faqa mina akoona Amoorana faqa qimannimiqau.
Maaqi qimasee qimamiqau. Maasa sia amana qeeqa dauna nifaaqa ati sia aukirausa nimianaura. Miqiqa maasa firaaqoo qisauruanoora.
Innee maasa daanna reeqa inneeqa faiqi namu nifaaqa ati aukusaifaqa minara kai maasa eedoo qianauranoo.
Miqimmasaifaqa maasa inniara eedoo qimasee inni faqa narí maree narí maree ifaranoo. Maasa inni qambaana maridaqa inni faqa moodaa maqannaa marianauranoo.
Innee sia mi ufanara eedoo qimasee nifaaqa ati ateekaifaqa maasa qeeqa dauna afiqamaree doo fuanaura.
Mi ufausara Qamoorafa faqa mina amaaku Seekeemmafa faqa iriseeqa amanee qiqau.
Seekeemmafa kai kaqi uqanna inoo misa qimamundee inau. Mifa Yakooboona araamunara aidi marunara miqinau. Seekeemmafa narí aiku asaukukiqari kaaqa uriqararafa marinau.
Amoorafa narí amaaku Seekeemmasandiri ufa suqimaru maqusanasaa faandaaura kooqiki oonuree nári maqusanaki marusa maaqi qimasee qimanniminau.

Maa fasiqausa aqoondiuqa maridaqa. Saifaqa maa maqanasaa maridaqa mana mana iqa nuaqa. Maa maqafa firaafa maridanoo. Misa faqa amana marifaranoo. Maasa misa niraamuqmaaka maraanaqa misa faqa maasaindi mareefaranoo.
Maa fasiqausa maasa qambaana marirara eedoo qidaqa moodaa mariranaki mariranara eedoo qidaqa. Maasa misa naanna reeqa qeeqa faiqi namu akoonaiqiuqa nifaaqa ati ateekaaqeera qidaqa.
Maasa miqianaqa misaki sipsipa burimakau aina marifa maasaindi kammiannoo. Anifaqa eedoo qianaqa maasa qambaana mariaqa.
Aiqama mi maqusanakinaasa Qamoorana faqa Seekeemmana faqa ufa iriseeqa eedoo qimasee aiqama akoonaiqi qisakoosa nifaaqa ati auku aqiqau.

Qaarammoo faasaana aiqaroofaqa nifaaqa ati aukuqoosa firaaqoo nammuana nidafi marufaqa Yakooboona amaaku qara Simeeoonafa faqa Reefifa faqa miqanda Dinnaa nammarina asooki qanda nári faaqaana qara mara maree umee kai Seekeemma maqusai ooru reeqara aiqama faiqí kumaaraa naru taikaqau.
Qamoorana faqa Seekeemmana faqa narusee Dinnaa nammarina Seekeemmana maaqakinaana afiqamaree doo quqasee fiqau.
Narusoofaqa Yakooboona faiqi namu akaqausa inaaqianna oonu reeqa nári nisookina rarisoona akiiqara mi maqusanakina aiqama ainaina maraqau.
Misa sipsipauqa faqa burimmakauqa faqa doonkiuqa faqa aiqama ainaina mi maqusanaki maruna faqa mi maqusana atiqara maru ainainausa aiqama maraqau.
Misa aiqama amiqira ainaina kai maraqau. Aiqama faiqi anaasee faqa maraqau. Aiqama maaqakinaa ainainauqa faqa maree fiqau.

Yakooboofa miqunara irinoo Simeeoonna faqa Reefina faqa maaqi qimasee qimanniminau. Inneeqara qini ummaaraki quqaqisaafanoo. Kannaa maqannaasa faqa Peerisaa maqannaasa faqa aiqama maa maqa maaqanaki mariasa qiniara fidiaqaammifaranoo. Qini faiqí sia moomoo mariafaqa, misa aiqama moodaanaki aniree qini dariqa aiqama maasa faiqi anaasee kuridi nimaqeefaranoo.
Yakooboofa miqi qufaqa miqanda narí qimamiqa qiqau. Maasa sia qeeqa qisookina quqaqaanaqa aanasaa aanaaseera foora kaqi maraqa nifaranoo.
